acceptanceCriteria: No mutation at 13k receipts exceeds a recorded latency bound across a refresh boundary (measured over more than 512 writes).
Refresh-versus-write race and checkpoint-bound-to-head tests still pass.
body:
Parent: V1-0645. Observed: at 13k receipts the periodic writer refresh (every 512 receipts) runs a complete audit of about 7 s inside the caller that triggers it. Expected: incremental refresh or off-caller refresh so no mutation pays seconds.

Source: batch 4 lanes for GitHub #641-#647, 2026-10-06 (branches claude/v1-0645-audit-outside-lock, claude/scale-tasks-v1-0893, claude/scale-core-v1-0416, claude/gh644-live-upgrade). Darwin 25.6.0, go1.27.1. Versions: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360).
title: V1-0645: writer refresh every 512 receipts runs a roughly 7 s complete audit inside the triggering caller
